{{Quote|A pretty girl can do more damage with a smile than a Sith with a lightsaber.|Gann Sakoal's father|<ref name="The Leak" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the '''father''' of [[Gann Sakoal]], a man who worked as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In Sakoal's youth, his father warned him of the dangers that a pretty girl could pose, and Sakoal was reminded of his father's words when he discovered that his wife [[Kelara Sakoal]] had had an affair.<ref name="The Leak" />
